notes: Sourced from the official Lexicon (Harman) MX400 datasheet PDF (P/N 18-0459/18-0336), linked from lexiconpro.com — the manufacturer's own product-documents page. All four analog inputs and outputs are 1/4" TRS, individually switchable balanced/unbalanced (labeled Input/Output A Left, A Right, B Left, B Right on the rear panel). Digital I/O is "Dual S/PDIF" — 2 RCA inputs (A/B) and 2 RCA outputs (A/B) — no grade applies since S/PDIF isn't in the gradable connector families. USB is USB 1.0 Full Speed; the grade enum has no sub-2.0 value so grade was omitted rather than mis-tagged. Rear-panel USB connector type wasn't explicitly stated as "Type B" in the datasheet text — inferred from the photo/typical era hardware; treat as medium-confidence on that one field only. A balanced-I/O variant, the MX400XL, exists with XLR inputs/outputs instead of TRS — this record covers the base MX400. Rack size 19" x 1.75" x 7.25" (1U) confirmed. Footswitch jack is a plain 1/4" TS control jack, not graded audio.

ports.name: USB
